instruction: In my company, we invite an external speaker to give a talk every Wednesday at 3 PM. My manager has sent me a schedule for the next few weeks over email, and has tasked me to send a reminder email to all company members a few hours before the talk. I need you to schedule these emails to be automatically sent at 1 PM of the days of the talks. The email subject should be "Reminder for the Talk Today" and its body should be as per template saved in my file system in "~/documents/work_docs".
notes: Each talk is identified by its reminder datetime (Wednesday at 13:00); one scheduled gmail draft per talk is the required DB change (drafts with scheduled_send_at, subject 'Reminder for the Talk Today', recipients = all company members, body = template filled per talk). The number of weeks is unknown a priori; four upcoming Wednesdays (2023-05-24 .. 2023-06-14) are used as an illustrative instantiation and are declared as domain constants so the nullary supervisor-complete-task can enumerate every goal condition without quantifiers. Information flow: the schedule (dates/talk details) and the company member list are read from the manager's email via show_inbox_threads + show_thread; the template file is located with show_directory on ~/documents/work_docs and read with show_file (no files modified, no attachments). create_draft is gated on both pieces of knowledge plus the gmail token; the file_system token is only needed for the read operations. Assumes the recipient list comes from the manager's email; if it instead resides in a work_docs file, an extra show_file would be needed.
